name: logseq-asset-linker
description: Construct Logseq asset links: convert a macOS/absolute file path or a Logseq namespaced page name into a relative Markdown link (or file:/// link) into the graph's assets/ directory. Use when the user gives a file path or [[Namespace/Page]] and wants the asset/image/PDF link, an asset filename, or an asset folder path. Do not use for ordinary page wikilinks (logseq-core / logseq-link-hygiene).
